title: AWS Cloud sustainability: PUE and WUE tables

title: AWS Sustainability Fact Sheet — Ohio

title: Measuring energy and water efficiency for Microsoft datacenters
source_notes: Primary source. Defines WUE numerator as water used for humidification and cooling and denominator as IT-equipment electricity; reports FY24/FY25 regional values.

title: 2025 Environmental Data Index
source_notes: Primary source. Reports 2024 facility electricity consumption in MWh and water withdrawal in ML. Derived facility intensities use these same-scope values but are not standard IT-energy WUE.

title: 2024 Sustainability Report
source_notes: Primary source. Reports annual average WUE for all sites and evaporative sites; footnote defines evaporative sites as data centers with cooling systems that utilize water.
